source: xemu targets/mega65/input_devices.c (matrix_*_to_petscii, after mega65-core's keymapper): the PETSCII the hardware typing queue ($D619) presents for the MEGA65's keys; the monitor cannot type a key, so there is no xmega65 recording
no_petscii: ALT combinations: the hardware gives them an ASCII code only ($D610), PETSCIIKEY reads $FF
